issue: Supported EURUSD shadow requests intermittently returned HTTP 422 for insufficient candle history and were incorrectly labelled UNSUPPORTED.
fix: Fallback to a fresh staged M1 history whenever supplied shadow candle history has fewer than 80 usable candles.
Classify HTTP 422 as UNSUPPORTED only when the response explicitly identifies an unsupported pair, horizon, or timeframe.
Treat insufficient-history 422 responses on supported tracks as UNAVAILABLE infrastructure faults.
Keep all shadow predictions research-only and influencedLiveSignal=false.
acceptance: A fresh EURUSD-5m signal must receive READY before settlement after deployment.
